name: Neverland ni Ikou!!
original_name: ネバーランドに行こう!!
source:
Two people confess to each other before the summer vacations. More than friends, less than lovers, they take tickets to an amusement part.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两人在暑假前互相告白。他们比朋友亲密，却还称不上恋人，于是买票前往游乐园。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
